_readme: Everything about the submission that is still undecided lives here. Change any value; make_submission.py reads it fresh every run. Placeholders in a command: {python} = the interpreter running make_submission.py, {workdir} = an empty scratch folder for this run.

hmm.description: Sticky HMM over tracking clues + learned control classifier, Viterbi per half (hmm/decode.py)

baseline.description: Organisers' nearest-player baseline, +/-125 frame vote. Only for testing this pipeline end to end.
